name: ArborVault
tagline: The operating system for the modern funeral home.
positioning: ArborVault gives funeral home owner-operators one console for case files, family communication, compliance, and payments.

hero.h1: Run every case with the composure families expect.
hero.sub: ArborVault unifies intake, arrangement conferences, product selection, and billing into a single system built for independent funeral homes — no spreadsheets, no double entry.

features.title: Case files that never lose a detail
features.description: Track each decedent from first call through interment with a structured record: authorizations, service logistics, and family contacts in one timeline.

features.title: Arrangement conferences, guided
features.description: Present caskets, urns, and packages on a shared screen, capture selections instantly, and generate an itemized General Price List that stays FTC-compliant.

features.title: Family portal & e-signatures
features.description: Let families review arrangements, upload photos for tributes, and sign authorizations remotely — cutting a full day off every arrangement.

features.title: Compliance without the binder
features.description: Automated GPL versioning, embalming consents, and state filing checklists keep your firm audit-ready across every jurisdiction you serve.

features.title: Billing tied to the case
features.description: Send statements, collect deposits, and reconcile insurance assignments the moment a service is finalized — no re-keying into accounting.

features.title: Scheduling across your locations
features.description: Coordinate viewings, chapel time, staff, and fleet in one calendar so nothing double-books during your busiest weeks.

testimonials.quote: We replaced four disconnected tools with ArborVault. Arrangement conferences that used to take two hours now take fifty minutes, and our GPL is finally accurate every single time.
testimonials.name: Margaret Halloran

testimonials.quote: The family portal changed how we serve. Relatives across three states signed authorizations overnight, and our arranging staff stopped chasing paperwork.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: Onboarding took a weekend. Within a month our billing reconciled to the penny and I could finally see case volume across both locations from my phone.
testimonials.name: Theresa Vance

pricing.blurb: For single-location firms handling their first cases in one system.
For growing funeral homes coordinating staff, chapels, and billing.
For multi-firm groups needing centralized oversight and controls.

homepage.footerBlurb: ArborVault is the operations platform for independent funeral homes — dignified service, disciplined back office, one system.
